title: Zomi Language Portal
shortDescription: AI translation between English and Zomi for members of the Zomi community.
fullDescription:
Zomi Language Portal brings English–Zomi translation to your phone. Built for the Zomi community — in Chin State and Manipur, and across the diaspora — the portal pairs modern AI translation with a member community of trusted contributors.

TRANSLATOR
• Translate English to Zomi and Zomi to English — swap direction with one tap
• Every result is marked as an official portal translation, with a confidence score
• Try a phrase instantly with built-in Zomi examples such as “Na dam maw?”
• Copy any translation to use it in messages, documents or study notes

YOUR MEMBER ACCOUNT
• Sign in free with Google or Apple
• Your translation history, account and verification status stay in sync across iPhone, Android and the web

VERIFIED CONTRIBUTORS
Pastors, teachers, translators and community leaders can request a verification badge. Verified members are recognised across the portal with a blue badge next to their name.

BUILT WITH CARE
• Clear AI notice: translations are produced by artificial intelligence and may contain errors — important material should be reviewed by a fluent speaker
• Privacy policy, terms and support links available in-app
• Contact support directly from the About screen

The translation service is available to portal members. Sign in is free.

Support: zomilanguage@zomi.net
Privacy: https://zomi.me/privacy
Terms: https://zomi.me/terms
releaseNotes: First internal test build of Zomi Language Portal. Includes the English–Zomi translator with official output badge and confidence score, Google and Apple sign-in, member accounts with verification requests, and support/legal links.
